items.quote: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do
items.claim: God asserts he will not hide his plans from Abraham

items.quote: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
items.claim: Abraham shall become a great and mighty nation through whom all nations will be blessed

items.quote: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him
items.claim: Abraham will command his children and household

items.quote: and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment
items.claim: Abraham's descendants shall keep the way of the LORD and practice justice

items.quote: that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him
items.claim: The LORD will fulfill the promises he has spoken concerning Abraham
